body: We’ve fine-tuned the 774M parameter GPT-2 language model using human feedback for various tasks, successfully matching the preferences of the external human labelers, though those preferences did not always match our own. Specifically, for summarization tasks the labelers preferred sentences copied wholesale from the input (we’d only asked them to ensure accuracy), so our models learned to copy. Summarization required 60k human labels; simpler tasks which continue text in various styles required only 5k. Our motivation is to move safety techniques closer to the general task of “machines talking to humans,” which we believe is key to extracting information about human values.
summaryZh: 本文介绍了利用人类偏好反馈对7.74亿参数的GPT-2语言模型进行微调的研究进展。通过收集人类对摘要和文本续写任务的反馈，研究团队探讨了如何将模型安全技术与人类价值观对齐，发现人类标签偏好对模型生成行为（如摘要复制）有着直接影响，为后续大模型对齐研究奠定了重要基础。

glossary.explanationZh: 微调，指在预训练模型的基础上使用特定数据进行进一步训练以适配特定任务。
人类偏好，通过人类对模型输出的评估来指导模型优化。
语言模型，能够理解和生成人类自然语言的机器学习模型。
文本摘要，将长文本压缩并提炼核心内容的技术任务。
人类价值观，AI对齐研究中期望大模型遵循的伦理和偏好准则。
